description:
One day, Kang Ju-Han, the president of Hakcheonpa, receives an unpleasant package. Inside the box was an old, broken rope. Ju-Han, who thought he might be one of the perverts who had always been interested in him, goes to the address written on the delivery box to seek revenge. In an abandoned factory in a deserted corner, a man, Seo Jeong-U, attacks Ju-Han from behind as he looks around. Jeong-U wraps a rope around Ju-Han's neck and tightens it. Ju-Han felt strange as he was being strangled. Jeong-U, who notices that Ju-Han has an erection, lets out an awkward laugh. Unlike Ju-Han, who thinks it's just a physiological phenomenon, Jeong-U realizes how he can make Kang Ju-Han, who is only proud, miserable. Kang Ju-Han is forced to have sex with Jeong-U. He curses and rejects Jeong-U, but at the same time, he is overwhelmed by the pleasure he feels for the first time.

(Source: Lezhin, translated)
